description: End-to-end checks, steering and docs for round 2 (plan.md steps 12-14; marketing-site tasks 40-42). Depends on FEAT-001 to FEAT-003 (the markup and attributes the e2e script checks). Rewrites the website motion checks in test/e2e/site.mjs for played sequences and How step sync, updates the steering and design-system motion text, the testing docs and the Kiro log.
steps: Step 12 of plan.md: .kiro/steering/accessibility.md rule 5 and .kiro/steering/design-system.md 'Spooky, but calm' name played sequences and How step sync (ADR-006 A7, A8) in place of scroll-linked state jumps; design/system/README.md Motion 'Website' paragraph lists A7 and A8, drops A5 and adds motion-state, motion-nudge, motion-play-lead, motion-frame, motion-frame-quick, motion-sweep; .kiro/agents/a11y-auditor.json website motion check text. Run `node scripts/validate-kiro-config.mjs`. Tick task 40.

Step 13: packages/web/test/e2e/site.mjs: remove section F's scroll-linked proof frame check (.site-frames--proof, lines ~453-476) and keep the opacity/transform-only and reduce-at-runtime checks; the 64-84px key checks (lines ~165 and ~285) select .nl-key:not(.site-key--touch) and the Touch keys are checked at exactly 72 and 128px (also with XL keys); add every task 41 check (step sync at 1280x800, 1920x1080, 1024x768 down and up; 'MS-8.12 How plays every step from the top on tall viewports' at 1024x1366 and 1920x1200; 'MS-8.12 step 1 plays with the whole How picture in view' at 1366x650, 1024x768, 1280x800; 'MS-8.11 tall drawings play in view' at 320x568 and 375x667 in 40px steps; 'Press a key to start' on one line at 320 and 1024px; reload at #access shows in-view drawings finished with no animation (MS-8.13); each drawing finished with no animations 4.5 s after the play line (MS-8.11); reduced motion finished and getAnimations() empty (MS-8.7); no overflow in stages, How stages, the desktop How picture or the proof figure at the 14 sizes and with XL keys, and 'MS-7.7 stages in a section have equal heights' (switch card excepted); CLS 0 while drawings play (MS-11.2, Chromium only); Conversation and Privacy 2 cards per row at 1280x800 and 1920x1080; the tall card's last child within 24px of its inner bottom at 1280x800 and 768x1024; bento Tab order (MS-10.9)) plus the review-3 case 'MS-8.11 drawings entered from above play in view' at 375x667 and 1280x800 (load at top, go to #faq, scroll up in 40px steps; at data-played='1' top >= -40 and bottom <= innerHeight + 40). WebKit-only skips print a note, as the script does today. Tick task 41.

Run it: confirm http://localhost:3000/ and /app answer 200 (curl --max-time 8); if not, send_message severity 'warning' asking the person to start or fix the dev server, and wait; never build, never restart the server. Then from packages/web `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs > /tmp/nl-site.log 2>&1` and `ENGINE=webkit BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs > /tmp/nl-site-webkit.log 2>&1`; fix failures in code or in the check (a check may change only when the spec's numbers allow it; a stage height overflow raises that stage one token step and is recorded in design.md 4.3).

Step 14: docs/testing/README.md 'The website' lists the round-2 motion checks; docs/KIRO_LOG.md: make sure the round-2 research and design row and one row per FEAT-001..004 exist (add any missing with `node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add`, credits blank, commands in plan.md step 14). Tick task 42.
Record in findings: the site.mjs results (Chromium and WebKit pass/fail counts), any stage height raised, and anything step 15 (full verification) must re-check.
acceptance_criteria: `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs` exits 0 in Chromium and with ENGINE=webkit (WebKit skips only the Chromium-only checks, with a note)
docs/KIRO_LOG.md has the round-2 design row and one row per FEAT, each a single table line
`node scripts/tm-lint.mjs` on every changed file exits 0; tasks.md rows 40-42 ticked; nothing committed
verification: BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/site.mjs (from packages/web, output to a file)
pnpm -r typecheck; pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run (output to files)
findings: RESULTS (dev server :3000, / and /app 200): site.mjs Chromium 371 ok, 0 failed, exit 0; ENGINE=webkit 361 ok, 0 failed, exit 0 (WebKit skips with a note: layout shift and LCP, and layout shift while drawings play). pnpm -r typecheck exit 0; pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run 377 of 377 (32 files) exit 0; validate-kiro-config and check-kiro-not-ignored exit 0; tm-lint clean on the 10 changed files. No stage height raised (every stage fit and equal-height check passed at the 14 sizes and with XL keys at all 14). CODE FIX OUTSIDE THE PLAN TEXT: the first site.mjs run failed 2 checks: 'MS-8.11 tall drawings play in view' at 320x568 (How step 1, 406px, never played going down) and 'MS-8.11 drawings entered from above play in view' at 375x667 (the proof figure, 654px, never played going up). Cause: a drawing taller than the play area (70% of the viewport) but not than the viewport crosses no threshold of the play-area or top-line observers while shouldPlay holds (windows of about 10-13px, smaller than a 40px scroll step). SiteMotion.tsx now creates a third play observer before the reveal observer: IntersectionObserver(onPlay, { rootMargin: '0px', threshold: [0.94, 0.95, 0.96, 0.97, 0.98, 0.99, 1] }); shouldPlay is unchanged, so a drawing entered from above plays with at most 6% of it above the viewport. Recorded in design.md 3.3 (new 'Whole viewport' bullet) and the SiteMotion header comment. The site-motion unit tests pass unchanged (they find observers by rootMargin; the reveal observer is still last); no unit case covers the third observer yet. STILL OPEN for step 15: a drawing taller than the viewport entered from above (the proof figure, 680px, at 320x568) gets no callback while shouldPlay holds and plays only when scrolled back down to the top line; not covered by any check. CHECK INTERPRETATION: 'MS-8.11 tall drawings play in view' checks bottom <= innerHeight + 1 only for a drawing that fits the viewport; a taller one (proof at 320x568) is checked by top >= -40 only, as shouldPlay plays it with its top at the top. SITE.MJS CHANGES: header comment; new helpers frames, keyWidths/keyChecks (.site .nl-key:not(.site-key--touch) 64-84px; .site-key--touch exactly 72 and 128px), stageFit/fitChecks (stage scroll size, data-play root inside its stage, every shown descendant inside .site-how__picture and figure.site-proof, equal .site-stage heights per section except .site-stage--switch), howState, howRange, drawingState (subtree getAnimations without site-reveal/site-fade-in), stepScroll (40px steps). Size pass: reduced motion also checks every [data-play] has data-played='instant'. XL pass now runs at all 14 sizes. New 'layout' pass at 320x568, 1024x768, 768x1024, 1280x800, 1920x1080 (hint one line, 2 cards per row, tall card gap 0px measured at 1280x800 and 768x1024, no CSS order/dense, Access card DOM order). Section F lost the .site-frames--proof check and gained 'marks every drawing finished' after reduce at runtime (MS-8.13). New round-2 blocks after the motion loop: step sync (1280x800, 1920x1080, 1024x768, down and up, plus the outline 0,1,0 with step 2 active), tall viewports 1024x1366 and 1920x1200 (played 1,2,3), step 1 in view (1366x650 picture 26-642 of 650; 1024x768 146-762 of 768; 1280x800 146-762 of 800), tall drawings 320x568 and 375x667, entered from above 375x667 (17 of 17) and 1280x800 (14 of 14), reload at #access 1280x800 (5 drawings instant, no animation), played sequences 1280x800 and 375x667 (all finished 4.5 s after the last play, CLS delta 0.0000 in Chromium). The reload case loads /#access and then reloads, as the task says. DOCS: .kiro/steering/accessibility.md rule 5 and design-system.md 'Spooky, but calm' name played sequences (A7) and How step sync (A8); design/system/README.md Motion 'Website' paragraph drops A5, adds A7, A8 and the 6 tokens with values; .kiro/agents/a11y-auditor.json website motion check text; docs/testing/README.md landing-page row and a round-2 motion list under 'The website'; KIRO_LOG row for FEAT-004 added (rows for research/design and FEAT-001..003 already existed); tasks.md 40, 41, 42 ticked. Nothing committed.
